title: Symbol definition — one entry of config/symbols.json
description: Definition of a single reel symbol. config/symbols.json is an array whose every element validates against this schema. Symbol ids follow the canonical set: WILD, SCATTER, premiums H1..H4 (H1 highest), lows L1..L5, feature-exclusive FX1.., MULT, CASH, COLLECT, MYSTERY, JP_MINI|JP_MINOR|JP_MAJOR|JP_GRAND, BLANK (hold-and-respin grids only).

id.description: Canonical symbol id, unique within the game.

displayName.description: Themed public name shown in the paytable/help screens.

tierRank.description: Pay-tier rank within the game, 1 = highest paying. Non-paying symbols (scatter without scatter pays, blank) still carry a rank for sorting help screens.

substitutes.description: Whether this symbol substitutes for others in win evaluation (true for wilds).

substitutesFor.description: Explicit list of symbol ids this symbol substitutes for. Omitted with substitutes true means: substitutes for every paying symbol except scatter and jackpot.

items.description: Symbol id this symbol can stand in for.

multiplierValues.description: Whole-number win multipliers this symbol can carry (multiplier wilds, MULT symbols). Mechanics needing half steps must use x100 fixed-point in a mult100 field of the feature config instead.

cashValueRangeX100.description: For kind "cash": inclusive range of bet-multiple values the symbol can carry, in integer hundredths of a bet (payX100 rule: 2.5x -> 250).

min.description: Lowest cash value in payX100 units.

max.description: Highest cash value in payX100 units; must be >= min (config validator).

appearsOnReels.description: Zero-based reel indices this symbol may appear on (in any reel set).

featureOnly.description: true = the symbol appears only inside feature tiers (never on base-game reel sets).

assets.description: Image asset references per visual state. Ids must exist in config/asset-manifest.json.

win.description: Win-celebration image (or animation atlas frame source) asset id.

blur.description: Motion-blurred image asset id shown while the reel spins.

minorUnits.description: Monetary amount in integer minor units (e.g. cents). Never a binary float.

tierId.description: Canonical scatter feature tier id (3 / 4 / 5+ scatters).

symbolId.description: Canonical symbol id, e.g. WILD, SCATTER, H1, L3, JP_GRAND.

projectSlug.description: Kebab-case project slug used for games/<slug>/.
